snippets.non_accrual: o accrual status if past due principal and interest are paid in cash and the portfolio company, in management’s judgment, is likely to continue timely payment of its remaining obligations. As of June 30, 2026, there were six investments on non-accrual status that in aggregate represented 4.2% and 1.8% of total debt investments at cost and fair value, respectively.

notes: No weighted-average risk rating found (many BDCs do not disclose one).
